channel.title: Microprocessors and Codesign
channel.description: Last 10 notes on Microprocessors and Codesign

item.title: CNAME
item.description: This plugin emits a CNAME record that points your subdomain to the default domain of your site. If you want to use a custom domain name like quartz.example.com for the site, then this is needed.

item.title: ComponentResources
item.description: This plugin manages and emits the static resources required for the Quartz framework. This includes CSS stylesheets and JavaScript scripts that enhance the functionality and aesthetics of the generated site.

item.title: ContentIndex
item.description: This plugin emits both RSS and an XML sitemap for your site. The RSS Feed allows users to subscribe to content on your site and the sitemap allows search engines to better index your site.

item.title: ContentPage
item.description: This plugin is a core component of the Quartz framework. It generates the HTML pages for each piece of Markdown content. It emits the full-page layout, including headers, footers, and body content, among others.

item.title: CrawlLinks
item.description: This plugin parses links and processes them to point to the right places. It is also needed for embedded links (like images). See Obsidian compatibility for more information.

item.title: CreatedModifiedDate

item.title: Description
item.description: This plugin generates descriptions that are used as metadata for the HTML head, the RSS Feed and in folder and tag listings if there is no main body content, the description is used as ...

item.title: ExplicitPublish

item.title: FolderPage
item.description: This plugin generates index pages for folders, creating a listing page for each folder that contains multiple content files. See folder and tag listings for more information.

item.title: Frontmatter
item.description: This plugin parses the frontmatter of the page using the gray-matter library. See Syntax, Obsidian compatibility and OxHugo compatibility for more information.
